lines.speaker: ARCHIVE // YEAR 2034
lines.text: You are Dr. Imane Kessler, systems analyst for the Deep Space Array. Three weeks ago, the Array detected a signal no natural process could have produced.

lines.speaker: DEEP SPACE ARRAY
lines.text: A narrowband burst arrived at 03:11 UTC. It is not language. It is structured.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: No glyphs. No images. The envelope looks like a machine that expects to be exercised. The sender has given us an experiment, not an explanation.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: Your assignment is to reconstruct the operation it encodes. We will change the inputs, observe the response, and keep only what survives every test.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE
lines.text: If the artifact can be understood, humanity will have learned its first word in an unknown language.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: The artifact is stable only when both stimulus lines are asserted. Conjunction. Logical, or something that behaves like it.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE
lines.text: Humanity now has one confirmed primitive. Interpretation remains contested.

lines.speaker: CRYOSLEEP PROTOCOL
lines.text: The next burst is not expected for years. You will sleep. Institutions will not.

lines.speaker: DEEP SPACE ARRAY
lines.text: A related fragment. Smaller. The return line disagrees with the stimulus.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: If the first artifact was conjunction, this may be inversion. Or it may only look that way.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: Negation. A complete Boolean basis is now in reach. That is a human conclusion. We still do not know if it is theirs.

lines.speaker: CRYOSLEEP PROTOCOL
lines.text: The Array has learned enough to predict the next interval. You will sleep for twenty years while the signal crosses the dark.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE
lines.text: The work survives its first investigators. Knowledge is beginning to outlive the people who found it.

lines.speaker: DEEP SPACE ARRAY
lines.text: The new fragment contains two recognizable behaviors. It is not repeating itself. It is composing.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: The response is active when Line A is present and Line B is absent. The sender expects us to combine what we have learned.

lines.speaker: DR. IMANE KESSLER
lines.text: The primitives are not isolated facts. They can be assembled into new behavior. We are no longer only recognizing the message. We are learning its grammar.

lines.speaker: ARCHIVE
lines.text: Three confirmed operations. The space between understanding and invention has become difficult to measure.
